title: Illumina Beadchip Amplification
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates sample distribution and the addition of [MA1](https://www.illumina.com/products/by-type/microarray-kits/infinium-global-screening.html) and [0.1 N NaOH](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/catalog/product/sigma/s2770?lang=en®ion=US). **Using the customizations fields, below set up your protocol.** * **P10 Multi Mount**: Select which mount (left or right) the P10 Multi is attached to. --- To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our [online store](https://shop.opentrons.com/) or contact our sales team at [info@opentrons.com](mailto:info@opentrons.com) * [Opentrons OT-2](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/ot-2) * [Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.15.0 or later)](https://opentrons.com/ot-app/) * [Opentrons P10 Multi-Channel Pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes) * [Opentrons 10µL Tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-tips) * [NEST 12-Well Reservoir, 15mL](https://labware.opentrons.com/nest_12_reservoir_15ml?category=reservoir) * Axygen 96-Well Plate (PCR-96-FS-C) * Abgene 96-Deep Well Plate (AB0765) * Reagents * Samples --- Slot 1: [NEST 12-Well Reservoir](https://labware.opentrons.com/nest_12_reservoir_15ml?category=reservoir) * A5: [MA1](https://www.illumina.com/products/by-type/microarray-kits/infinium-global-screening.html) * A9: [0.1 N NaOH](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/catalog/product/sigma/s2770?lang=en®ion=US) Slot 2: Abgene 96-Deep Well Plate (AB0765) Slot 3: Axygen 96-Well Plate (PCR-96-FS-C) Slot 4: [Opentrons 10µL Tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-tips) Slot 5: [Opentrons 10µL Tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-tips)
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Select P10 mount
steps.instruction: Using the protocol customization fields, choose whether the P10 Multi‑Channel Pipette is mounted on the left or right side of the OT‑2 robot.

steps.title: Load labware onto deck
steps.instruction: Place the following labware in the indicated slots on the OT‑2 deck: Slot 1 – NEST 12‑Well Reservoir (15 mL); load MA1 reagent into well A5 and 0.1 N NaOH into well A9. Slot 2 – Abgene 96‑Deep Well Plate (catalog AB0765). Slot 3 – Axygen 96‑Well Plate (PCR‑96‑FS‑C). Slot 4 – Opentrons 10 µL tip rack. Slot 5 – Opentrons 10 µL tip rack.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons Protocol Designer, input all required parameters for the Illumina Beadchip Amplification (e.g., sample identifiers, volumes) as prompted.

steps.title: Generate protocol file
steps.instruction: Click “Download your protocol” to save the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload to OT‑2 App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (version 3.15.0 or later) and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Verify that the physical deck layout matches the deck map shown in the protocol (labware positions as described in the Load labware step).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, perform calibration of the tip racks, the reservoir, and the P10 Multi‑Channel Pipette according to the on‑screen instructions.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to start the automated sample distribution and addition of MA1 and 0.1 N NaOH.
